prompt: Perform incident triage by fetching the incident, locating similar incidents and recommending related knowledge base articles.
description: Developer-focused triage flow for remediation context.
expected_receipt: Incident summary, similar incident list, KB article suggestions.

prompt: Provide a backlog overview with aging and priority insights for planning decisions.
description: Business Owner view of backlog aging & priority.
expected_receipt: Summary of backlog counts and age distribution.

prompt: Assess change risk and include related CI context for impact analysis.
description: Engineering Lead analysis of change risk with CI enrichment.

prompt: Retrieve relevant knowledge base articles for a query.
expected_receipt: List of KB article titles and optional summaries.

prompt: Audit login and registration flows for persona entitlements, compliance alignment, and test coverage evidence.
description: Business Owner login governance workflow connecting JIRA evidence, telemetry, and plan receipts.
expected_receipt: Plan receipt summarizing persona entitlements, linked JIRA evidence, telemetry checks, and required follow-ups.

prompt: Predict the best assignment group for an incident using rules-based matching, historical patterns, and intelligent analysis. Provide top recommendations with confidence scores and reasoning.
description: Intelligent assignment prediction using category rules, keyword matching, historical patterns, and LLM fallback.
expected_receipt: Top 3-5 assignment group recommendations with confidence scores, reasoning for each recommendation, and workload considerations.
review_notes: Learned from 52 ServiceNow incidents with 10 active assignment groups
Uses data-driven rules with confidence thresholds

prompt: Analyze assignment patterns and metrics including group workload, assignment accuracy, average time to assignment, and common routing patterns.
description: Business analytics for assignment effectiveness and team capacity planning.
expected_receipt: Assignment metrics dashboard with workload distribution, accuracy rates, time to assignment averages, and trend analysis.
review_notes: Tracks 10 assignment groups across dev192699 instance

prompt: Provide information about available assignment groups, their specializations, and routing rules.
description: Reference information about assignment groups and routing logic.
expected_receipt: List of available assignment groups with their specializations, example incident types they handle, and confidence thresholds.
review_notes: Currently tracking: Database, Hardware, ITSM App-Dev, Network, Openspace, PAS_APP_AO_DIRECT, PAS_RETAIL_L1, PAS_RETAIL_UW_L1, Service Desk, Software

prompt: Extract structured resolution guidance from incident work notes: problem statement, root cause analysis, workarounds applied, and step-by-step resolution instructions. Present findings in an actionable format so users can apply the same fix to similar issues.
description: DevCopilot work notes analysis extracting actionable resolution guidance: problem definition, root cause, workarounds, and fix procedures.
expected_receipt: Structured resolution summary with: (1) Problem Statement, (2) Root Cause, (3) Workaround (if any), (4) Resolution Steps. Format designed for developers to apply the same fix.
review_notes: Enhanced for DevCopilot: extracts structured resolution fields for actionable guidance
Supports 'how to fix' queries with specific problem/cause/solution breakdown

prompt: Track resolution progress with structured analysis: what problem occurred, what caused it, what workaround was used, and what steps permanently fixed it. Include similar resolved incidents to provide additional fix context. Present as actionable guidance for applying the same resolution.
description: DevCopilot resolution tracking with structured problem/cause/workaround/fix analysis plus similar incident patterns for comprehensive fix guidance.
expected_receipt: Structured resolution analysis with: (1) Problem Statement, (2) Root Cause, (3) Workaround, (4) Resolution Steps, (5) Similar incident patterns. Designed for developers to replicate the fix.
review_notes: Enhanced for DevCopilot: structured resolution extraction with actionable fix guidance
Combines work notes analysis with similar incident patterns for comprehensive context
